_comment: Core-preamble token budgets (chars/4 heuristic) per MILE-30. Measures ONLY the section before CORE_PREAMBLE_MARKER -- @-included reference content is excluded by design. Coordinator gets the largest budget since it owns orchestration/return-contract complexity that can't be fully delegated to references without losing hard-rule visibility; planner is next given its goal-backward derivation logic; verifier/debugger/executor get progressively smaller budgets proportionate to their current sizes, since they have narrower single-purpose roles. Executor carries a modestly larger budget (6300) than debugger because the agent-messaging layer adds two hard-rule-adjacent SendMessage hooks that MUST stay visible in the preamble to be reliable -- the App #1 upward continuation signal inside the self-stop path and the App #6 human-relay fast-path inside the checkpoint protocol; the fuller App #4/App #5 detail lives after the marker (unbudgeted) and in references/agent-messaging.md.
